scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @aicount/contracts && npm run build -w @aicount/backend-common
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @aicount/document-service && npm run build -w @aicount/rule-engine && npm run build -w @aicount/reconciliation-service && npm run build -w @aicount/anomaly-service && npm run build -w @aicount/legal-rag-service && npm run build -w @aicount/api
scripts.typecheck:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @aicount/document-service && npm run typecheck -w @aicount/rule-engine && npm run typecheck -w @aicount/reconciliation-service && npm run typecheck -w @aicount/anomaly-service && npm run typecheck -w @aicount/legal-rag-service && npm run typecheck -w @aicount/api
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:shared && vitest run tests/backend
